chunks: Stone the Jamarat on each day after sunrise until zawal, and the closer it is to zawal, the better. A concession has also been narrated from the beginning of the day until its end.

Say what you said on the day you stoned Jamrat al-'Aqabah. Begin with the first Jamarah and stone it with seven pebbles from its front side, and do not stone it from above. Then stand on the left side of the path, praise Allah, Mighty and Majestic, extol Him, and send blessings upon the Prophet and his family. Then move forward a little, supplicate to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and ask Him to accept from you. Then move forward a little and supplicate to Allah, then move forward a little more. Then do the same at the middle one: stone it with seven pebbles, and do as you did at the first, standing by it and supplicating. Then proceed to the third, maintaining tranquility and dignity, and stone it with seven pebbles, and do not stand by it.

key_terms.الزَّوَالِ: midday decline of the sun, the preferred endpoint of the time mentioned
key_terms.السَّكِينَةُ: calmness and composure while proceeding to the final Jamarah
key_terms.الْجِمَارَ: the Jamarat, the ritual stoning sites in Mina
key_terms.الْوَقَارُ: dignity and gravity in conduct during the rite
key_terms.جَمْرَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ: the Jamrah of al-'Aqabah, whose stoning formula is to be repeated
key_terms.حَصَيَاتٍ: small pebbles used for the ritual stoning
key_terms.رُخْصَةٌ: a concession allowing a wider time for performing the rite

ai.seo_question: How should the Jamarat be stoned during the days of Tashriq according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This passage gives the fiqh of stoning the Jamarat during the days of Tashriq, specifying the preferred time and a broader permitted time. It also outlines the order of the three Jamarat, the number of pebbles, the posture and place of supplication, and where one should and should not stop for du'a.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
STONING THE JAMARAT
On each day of Tashreeq (the 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhul-Hijjah), perform the stoning of the Jamarat between sunrise and midday (zawal). While stoning closer to zawal is preferred, there is a narration allowing it from early morning to evening.

1.	Start with the First Jamarah (Jamarah Al-Ula):
o	Throw seven pebbles at it, one at a time, from its front side, not from the top.
o	After stoning, stand to the left of the path, praise Allah (swt), send blessings upon the Prophet and his family, and supplicate to Allah (swt).
o	Move a little forward and repeat your supplication.
2.	Proceed to the Second Jamarah (Jamarah Al-Wusta):
o	Similarly, throw seven pebbles, and follow the same steps as with the first: stoning, praising Allah (swt), sending blessings upon the Prophet, and making dua.
o	Stand near it and make your supplications.
3.	Move to the Third Jamarah (Jamarah Al-Aqabah):
o	Throw seven pebbles at it but do not stop for supplication here. Continue with dignity, maintaining calmness and composure.
During each stoning, repeat the supplications you said while stoning Jamarah Al-Aqabah on the Day of Sacrifice (10th Dhul-Hijjah).
